title: "Why this site is organized as a research graph"

A durable academic website should not be a reverse-chronological activity log. The primary unit is a research question. Publications, software, datasets, and notes are artifacts connected to that question.

This structure makes the site useful even when posting is infrequent: mature pages can be revised as the underlying research develops.

## Content model

**Research** defines the problem space. **Publications** record formal outputs. **Tools** expose reusable software. **Notes** capture original technical reasoning. **Reading** records understanding of external literature.

## Maintenance rule

Create a permanent page only when the content is likely to remain useful after the immediate task is finished.
